## 📋 Pull Request Summary
<!-- Provide a clear, concise summary of the problem and proposed solution -->

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] 🐛 `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] 🔨 `refactor`: Refactoring without functional changes
- [ ] 📚 `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] 🛡️ `security`: Security patches or dependency updates
- [ ] ⚙️ `ci`: CI/CD pipeline or build configuration

## 🌿 Git Strategy & Branch Standards
- [ ] Branch follows convention: `feat/<issue-id>-<description>` or `fix/<issue-id>-<description>`
- [ ] Commits adhere to Conventional Commits format (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] Branch rebased on latest `main` without merge conflicts

## 🔍 Quality & Security Checklist
- [ ] Unit & integration tests pass locally (`pytest backend/tests`)
- [ ] SonarQube quality gate verified (No new blocker/critical code smells)
- [ ] Trivy vulnerability scan clean (Zero CRITICAL / HIGH security findings)
- [ ] Grounded evidence & citation traceability preserved
- [ ] Strict refusal mechanism maintained for unsupported error codes
